'''Grummalt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he and his men were posted at the [[Republic Resettlement Zone]], protecting [[General/Legends|General]] [[Faraire]]. [[Empire's Wrath|The apprentice of]] [[Darth Baras]], on a mission to kill Faraire, stormed the compound and engaged Grummalt and his men, killing them all.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Grummalt appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Sith Warrior class mission on Taris.
